patterns.note: Sections frequently feature full-bleed, high-contrast imagery or large typographic elements that fill the viewport, creating a dramatic and immersive experience.
The site uses extremely oversized, heavy sans-serif typography for primary headings and section titles, often acting as a dominant visual element or a mask for imagery.
A stark monochrome palette of black and white dominates the backgrounds and text, with vibrant, often cool-toned (blue/teal) imagery providing the primary color accents.

As the user scrolls, the initial hero image grid dynamically transforms, revealing new content within its segmented structure, followed by a full-screen takeover where massive text acts as a mask to reveal background imagery.
Content is presented in distinct, full-width sections, often with dark backgrounds, using large, impactful headlines to introduce each segment.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a grid of image elements that animate and swap content on scroll, creating a dynamic visual introduction. This is likely achieved using GSAP's ScrollTrigger to control the timing and transformation of individual grid cells.

A prominent scroll-triggered effect involves large, bold text filling the screen, where the negative space of the letters acts as a mask to reveal a background image. This creates a powerful visual transition and content reveal.
Overall page content is revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as sections enter the viewport, maintaining a fluid and engaging scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, heavy sans-serif headings (~8-10x body) create strong visual impact, contrasted with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to image containers and interactive elements, providing a soft contrast to the otherwise sharp typographic forms.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and large elements, creating a sense of grandeur and allowing content to breathe.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of typography as a primary visual and interactive element, particularly the full-screen text masks that reveal imagery on scroll. The combination of brutalist-scale type with dynamic, fluid image reveals creates a highly memorable and engaging experience that goes beyond typical hero sections.
